description: felyx Antwerp is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by FELYX BELGIUM. GBFS makes real-time data feeds in a uniform format publicly available online, with an emphasis on findability. In case of interest, please contact felyx to discuss if and how access can be granted.
